newsitem.title: UK: Guinness shares up after SocGen "buy" note.
newsitem.headline: Guinness shares up after SocGen "buy" note.

text.p: Shares in Guinness Plc rose on Thursday as analysts at SocGen repeated a "buy" recommendation and said they expected the company's full-year results on March 20 to be accompanied by a share buy-back or special dividend.
The stock was up 6-1/2p, or 1.4 percent, at 474-1/2 by 1510 GMT in active trade of 6.4 million shares.

Analyst Nick Lyall at the brokerage said underlying trading for United Distillers in emerging markets and for Guinness brewing worldwide was improving and that the company remained financially strong.
He said the group "remains committed to returning surplus financial resources to shareholders," which could be in the form of a buy-back of 100 million shares or a special dividend of up to 25p.
SocGen expects pre-tax profit to rise to 963 million stg in 1996 from 940 million a year before.
